subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` make recovery of an accepted disconnected Gateway run the default before retaining the existing automatic isolated embedded fallback when recovery cannot prove the outcome?
rationale: This is a user-visible compatibility choice between avoiding duplicate remote execution and preserving the established automatic local-rerun experience; the linked canonical issue was filed specifically for maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt recover-first
options.body: Use wait plus cache-only replay before the existing isolated fallback, preserving fallback only after bounded recovery cannot establish a terminal result.

options.title: Keep rerun-first
options.body: Retain the current automatic isolated embedded fallback as the first response to an ambiguous disconnect and do not add the new recovery protocol path.

options.title: Split behavior by delivery mode
options.body: Use recovery-first for `--deliver` while retaining current interactive behavior, with explicit tests and documentation for both modes.

recommendation.title: Adopt recover-first
recommendation.body: Use wait plus cache-only replay before the existing isolated fallback, preserving fallback only after bounded recovery cannot establish a terminal result.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged change established the current isolated fallback contract that this PR proposes to precede with recovery.
